name: leandojo_benchmark_4_corpus
description: Leandojo Benchmark 4 Corpus is a collection of text-based problems and solutions designed to evaluate language models' reasoning and problem-solving capabilities on structured, sequential tasks. It measures a model's ability to produce correct, formatted outputs given prompt-style problem statements across a variety of short tasks. The corpus is intended for automated exact-match-style evaluation of generated answers.
reputation: A niche benchmark used in research on reasoning and structured output generation, with limited but growing adoption.
